subject: Money
title: Leverage Amplification
description: A quick, practical guide to Leverage Amplification.

hook.text: You have $10,000 and borrow $90,000 to invest. A 10% rise: 100% profit. A 10% fall: you're wiped out completely.

buildup.text: Leverage means borrowing to invest. It multiplies gains in good times and losses in bad times.

discovery.text: Cheap credit fuels bubbles. When loans are easy, speculation soars. Everyone borrows to buy more.

twist.text: When prices drop, leveraged investors get margin calls: pay up or we sell. Forced selling crashes prices further.

climax.text: Lehman Brothers was leveraged 30:1 in 2008. A 3% drop in assets wiped out all their capital.

punchline.text: Leverage turns a stumble into a cliff.

quiz.question: How does leverage amplify a financial bubble?
options: Borrowed money magnifies both gains and losses
